summary: Verified iteration-7 Search+Filters feature. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed (category dedupe, brand-aware search, price/discount/stock/subcategory/brand filters, combined filters). Frontend: filter-panel renders on desktop and via drawer on mobile (filter-button). Only relevant subcategories & brands are shown as facets. Category list shows 10 unique names — no 'Home needs' duplicate anywhere. Category, subcategory, brand, discount chips, in-stock toggle, price slider, and Clear all all work; results-count updates correctly. Search for 'Moong dal' returns 1 result with correct facets; searching 'rice' switches results to 3 items (filters recompute).
critical_code_review_comments: products.py: min_price/max_price/min_discount/in_stock filters use post-processing after enrich; efficient enough for current dataset but for large catalogs consider Mongo-side computation of discount_percent or persisting it.

categories.py _dedupe_by_name silently drops duplicates on read — correct behavior for now, but recommend adding a unique compound index (name lower, parent_id) to prevent future dup inserts (write-side fix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public search page /products?search=... works without login. Location auto-selected (Banjara Hills) by StoreContext. Filter data-testids: filter-panel, filter-button, filter-cat-<id>, filter-cat-all, filter-sub-<id>, filter-brand-<id>, filter-price (slider), filter-discount-10/25/50, filter-instock, filter-clear, results-count. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_search_filters.py run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` env exported.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification pass. All previously reported issues (duplicate 'Home needs', missing brand/subcategory filters) are resolved.
